data.name: VamsiRaj
data.gender_notes: VamsiRaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vamsi: Lord Vamshi, the god of the forest and protector of the animals. Raj: King. This name evokes a sense of power and protection, and is often given to boys who are destined to become leaders and protectors. The name VamsiRaj carries the meaning “Lord Vamshi, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu. Parents who choose VamsiRaj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vamshi, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to bring the blessings of Lord Vamshi, the god of the forest and protector of all creatures. It is also a reminder of the power and responsibility that comes with being a leader and protector.
data.etymology: VamsiRaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vamshi, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of VamsiRaj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name VamsiRaj has its roots deep in Hindu culture, specifically referring to Lord Vamshi, a god revered for his protection and care over the forest and its inhabitants. This name implies a connection to nature and a sense of duty towards protecting and preserving it. The 'Raj' part of the name signifies leadership and power. Together, these meanings inspire an individual to uphold their responsibility towards their community, culture, and the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name VamsiRaj lies in its connection to the divine. The name represents the union of two gods - Lord Vamshi and the idea of being a king. Lord Vamshi is revered as the protector and preserver of all animals and the forest. This name imparts the spiritual meaning that the individual is a person allied with the divine power, given the responsibility to protect and care for their community and the natural world. It signifies a moral duty and a call to act as a spiritual leader.
data.spiritual_symbolism: VamsiRaj: The serpent (Vamsi) king (Raj). Symbolizes the inner awakening of the kundalini, the divine serpent power, leading to enlightenment and rulership over one's desires and instincts.

historical_references.reference: VamsiRaj was a renowned poet and king in the Andhra dynasty of South India, known for composing the epic 'Andhra Mahabharata'. He ruled from approximately 450 to 500 CE.
historical_references.context: Andhra Mahabharata, poet, king, South India, Andhra dynasty

historical_references.reference: Another reference to VamsiRaj is found in the 'Skanda Purana', where he is mentioned as a sage and a devout follower of Lord Shiva. He is believed to have lived during the 12th century CE.
historical_references.context: Skanda Purana, sage, devout follower of Lord Shiva
